From f033c87fda47e272bb4f75dc7b03677261d91158 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Stein <alexander.stein@ew.tq-group.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2023 08:15:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] media: amphion: Fix VPU core alias name

Starting with commit f6038de293f2 ("arm64: dts: imx8qm: Fix VPU core
alias name") the alias for VPU cores uses dashes instead of underscores.
Adjust the alias stem accordingly. Fixes the errors:
amphion-vpu-core 2d040000.vpu-core: can't get vpu core id
amphion-vpu-core 2d050000.vpu-core: can't get vpu core id

Fixes: f6038de293f2 ("arm64: dts: imx8qm: Fix VPU core alias name")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Stein <alexander.stein@ew.tq-group.com>
Reviewed-by: Ming Qian <ming.qian@nxp.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil-cisco@xs4all.nl>
Signed-off-by: Mauro Carvalho Chehab <mchehab@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/media/platform/amphion/vpu_core.c b/drivers/media/platform/amphion/vpu_core.c
index 1af6fc9460d4..3a2030d02e45 100644
--- a/drivers/media/platform/amphion/vpu_core.c
+++ b/drivers/media/platform/amphion/vpu_core.c
@@ -642,7 +642,7 @@ static int vpu_core_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 		return -ENODEV;
 
 	core->type = core->res->type;
-	core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu_core");
+	core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu-core");
 	if (core->id < 0) {
 		dev_err(dev, "can't get vpu core id\n");
 		return core->id;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/media/platform/amphion/vpu_core.c`**
   - The line that retrieves the VPU core ID has been modified. 
   - Changed from:
     ```c
     core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu_core");
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu-core");
     ```
   - This change updates the alias name from using an underscore (`_`) to a dash (`-`), aligning it with the new naming convention established in a previous commit.

### Relationships

- The modification in `vpu_core.c` directly addresses the issue caused by the change made in commit `f6038de293f2`, which altered the alias naming convention for VPU cores from underscores to dashes. 
- The patch resolves the errors related to retrieving the VPU core ID, specifically the errors indicating that the system could not get the VPU core ID for the specified devices. By updating the alias name in the code, it ensures compatibility with the new naming convention and fixes the reported errors.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu_core");
```
Reason:
The code was referencing the old alias format "vpu_core" (using an underscore) instead of the updated format "vpu-core" (using a dash) introduced in a previous commit. This mismatch caused the function `of_alias_get_id` to fail in retrieving the correct VPU core ID, leading to the error messages indicating that the VPU core ID could not be obtained.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
core->id = of_alias_get_id(dev->of_node, "vpu-core");
```
Reason:
The patch updates the alias name from "vpu_core" to "vpu-core", aligning it with the new naming convention. This change allows the function `of_alias_get_id` to correctly retrieve the VPU core ID, thus resolving the errors related to obtaining the VPU core ID.
